metadata.title: ClipBridge – Instant Clipboard & File Sync
metadata.description: Sync clipboard text and transfer files between devices instantly via WebRTC. End-to-end encrypted, zero registration or passwords required.

home.tagline: Establish an instant, end-to-end encrypted direct connection between devices.

room.errorDescNotFound: The room you tried to join does not exist or has expired. Please return to the homepage and create a new room.
room.errorDescFull: There are already two devices connected to this room. One of them must leave before you can join.
